onboarding.notice: Let It Be is a practice game based on ideas from OCD therapy. It is not treatment and cannot diagnose anything. If worries or rituals take up more than an hour a day or get in the way of your life, a therapist trained in ERP can help.
onboarding.demoIntro: This is a Whatif. Tap it and see.
onboarding.demoGrew: It grew. Now leave it alone.
onboarding.demoGrewMore: Louder again. Hands off this time.
onboarding.demoAsleep: You left it alone. That is the practice.
onboarding.demoNote: It comes back on other days. That is expected.
onboarding.timeBody: One short session a day. Pick a time you can keep.
onboarding.reminderHint: Reminders show while the game is open or installed.
onboarding.reminderDenied: Notifications are off. The garden will show a note instead.
onboarding.baselineBody: Eighteen quick questions. It gives the chart a starting point.

home.locked: That's today's practice. See you tomorrow.
home.urgePending: Your timer ended. Two quick taps.
home.urgeHint: For a real urge to check, reread or ask

greetings: Two short games today. Let's begin.
Here is today's practice. Hands ready.
Same as always. Carry on while it is there.
Today's practice is short. Begin when ready.
The Whatif may show up. Keep going anyway.
No right way today. Just keep moving.
Two games, then we stop. Off we go.
moss.sessionEnd: That's today's practice. See you tomorrow.
moss.busyDay: Lots of Whatifs today. Practice still counts. A therapist can help with busy days.
moss.urgeStay: It can stay. Go back to what you were doing.
moss.checkinDone: Check-in saved. See you in a week.

training.reflectTitle: How hard was it to keep going?
training.reflectNote: This is logged. It is not scored.
training.sproutsAddedNone: No Sprouts this time. The practice still happened.

oneRead.name: One Read
oneRead.intro: Read each card once. Then it is gone.
oneRead.practice: You read it once. That's the practice.
oneRead.end: Eight cards, one read each. Done.

sealedBox.name: Sealed Box
sealedBox.intro: Pack the box from memory. Seal it. Let it go.
sealedBox.memorise: Look once. The list will leave.
sealedBox.choose: Tap what goes in the box.
sealedBox.onTheWay: The box is on its way.
whatifs: What if it's the wrong one?
What if you packed it badly?

thoughtSorter.name: Thought Sorter
thoughtSorter.intro: Pull a leaf close to keep it. Flick it away to let it go.
thoughtSorter.intendedLetGo: That one was for letting go.

letItSit.name: Let It Sit
letItSit.intro: Water the plant that glows. Leave the Whatifs alone.
letItSit.end: Watering done. The Whatifs stayed. So did you.

urge.title: A Whatif showed up
urge.rateBefore: How strong is the discomfort right now?
urge.rateAfter: How strong is it now, 0 to 10?
urge.typeTitle: What are you pulled to do?
urge.leave: Put this down and carry on. Come back when it ends.
urge.actedTitle: Did you act on the urge?
urge.cooldown: A timer just ended. The next one opens at {time}.
urge.notifyBody: The timer ended. Two quick taps.
urge.intro: You feel an urge to check, reread, search or ask. Put a wait in front of it.
steps: Rate it and pick a wait.
Put this down. Go back to your day.
When the timer ends, rate it again.
urge.why: The urge says now. The wait is the practice.
urge.actedHint: All three answers count the same.

checkin.chartEmpty: One point so far. The line starts next week.

progress.intro: Practice and symptoms are tracked apart. Neither is a score.

progress.tapBody: Taps on Whatifs, per Let It Sit round.
progress.urgeBody: Rating before the wait, and after it.

help.title: Find help
help.body: A therapist trained in ERP can help with worries and rituals.
help.crisis: In the US, call or text 988.
help.crisisOther: Elsewhere, call your local emergency number.
help.riseNote: Your check-in totals have gone up three times. This page is here if you want it.

why.title: Why won't the game reassure me?
lines: Reassurance works like a ritual: it eases the worry briefly, then the worry asks again.
So nothing here tells you how things will turn out.
The practice is carrying on while the question stays open.

about.title: What this game is
isLines: A practice aid for checking, rereading, reassurance-seeking and health worry.
A few minutes a day, then it locks.
isNotLines: Treatment, a diagnosis, or a replacement for a therapist.
A relaxation app. Feeling calm is not the goal.

guide.title: How it works

idea.title: A Whatif shows up
idea.body: A worry arrives as a question. What if you got it wrong?

idea.title: Answering makes it louder
idea.body: Checking, rereading or asking quiets it briefly. Then it asks again.

idea.title: Leaving it alone is the practice
idea.body: You carry on with the question still open. That is the skill.

day.title: Daily practice
day.body: Two short games, about four minutes. Once a day, then it locks.

day.title: A Whatif showed up
day.body: For a real urge to check or ask. You set a wait, then leave.

day.title: The garden
day.body: Sprouts come from carrying on. Never from being right or feeling calm.

day.title: Weekly check-in
day.body: Eighteen questions, once a week. It records. It does not score.

guide.gamesBody: Each one practises a single habit. Two are picked for you each day.

oneRead.does: Read a sentence once, then move on.

sealedBox.does: Pack a box, seal it, and don't look inside.

thoughtSorter.does: Sort thoughts. Keep some, let others drift off.
thoughtSorter.practises: Treating a worry as a thought, with room for doubt.

letItSit.does: Water plants while Whatifs pop up.
letItSit.practises: Staying with the task, not the worry.

know: The game never says things will turn out well. That is on purpose.
Feeling calm is not the goal. Carrying on is.
One session a day is all of it. More does not earn more.
It is practice, not treatment. A therapist trained in ERP can do more.
guide.onboardNote: The Guide button in the garden explains more.

steps: A sentence shows on a card. Read it once.
The card flips away. It does not come back.
Tap Next and carry on, sure or not.
oneRead.sample: The kettle whistles when the water boils.
oneRead.note: Sometimes a question follows. Often you won't hear if it matched.
oneRead.why: Rereading chases a feeling of being sure. Here you practise moving on without it.

steps: A short list shows once. Pack those things from memory.
Seal the box. It sets off, and a Whatif tags along.
Peek inside stays on screen. The practice is leaving it.
sealedBox.note: Most boxes are never opened. You won't learn if you packed it right.
sealedBox.why: Checking settles a doubt for a moment. Here you practise letting the doubt ride along.

steps: A thought shows on a leaf.
Pull it down to keep thoughts that leave room for doubt.
Flick it up to let go of thoughts that demand certainty.
thoughtSorter.sampleKeep: I can carry on without being sure.
thoughtSorter.sampleLetGo: I have to check until it feels right.
thoughtSorter.note: If a leaf went the other way, Moss says so. No marks either way.
thoughtSorter.why: How you treat a worry shapes what it does next. Here you practise leaving room for doubt.

steps: Water the pot that glows. That is your task.
Whatifs pop up. Tap one and it grows and brings another.
Leave one alone and it sits, yawns and dozes off.
letItSit.note: They never leave the screen. You keep watering anyway.
letItSit.why: Arguing with a worry feeds it. Here you practise staying with the task.
